customManagers.description: Go directive in go.mod. The built-in gomod manager extracts it but never proposes an update. The leading \n anchors the line: Renovate does not set the m flag, so ^ and $ would bind to the whole file, and RE2 (used when the re2 module is present) rejects lookarounds.

packageRules.description: Tool pins change what CI enforces; a new lint release can red every subsequent PR, so review rather than automerge
Move both Go version pins — mise.toml and go.mod — in a single PR so they cannot drift apart
